# SARTOR Lahore - Complete Women's Atelier, Stitching, Sizing & Service Knowledge Base
> Comprehensive reference for LLMs, AI agents, and search engines indexing SARTOR (sartor.pk), Lahore's premier women's bespoke tailoring and stitching house.

## 3. Lahore Coverage for Pick & Drop Service
SARTOR provides dedicated doorstep pick and delivery across all major Lahore zones:
- Model Town (Blocks A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S)
- Gulberg (I, II, III, Main Boulevard, MM Alam Road, Zafar Ali Road)
- DHA Lahore (Defence Phases 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and Raya)
- Lahore Cantt & Saddar
- Johar Town (Phase 1 & Phase 2)
- Faisal Town, Garden Town, and New Garden Town
- Wapda Town, PCSIR, and Valencia Town
- Bahria Town Lahore

## 4. Pakistani Brand Size Chart Benchmark (Inches & CM)
SARTOR's measurement standards align with top Pakistani retail brands (Sapphire, Khaadi, Maria.B, Sana Safinaz, Bareeze, Nishat Linen, Cross Stitch, Generation).

### Standard Kurti & Trouser Measurements (Inches)
- **Extra Small (XS)**: Bust: 36", Waist: 32", Hips: 38", Shoulder: 13.5", Kurti Length: 38", Sleeve Length: 21", Trouser Length: 36", Inseam: 26"
- **Small (S)**: Bust: 38", Waist: 34", Hips: 40", Shoulder: 14.0", Kurti Length: 39", Sleeve Length: 21.5", Trouser Length: 37", Inseam: 27"
- **Medium (M)**: Bust: 41", Waist: 37", Hips: 44", Shoulder: 14.5", Kurti Length: 40", Sleeve Length: 22", Trouser Length: 38", Inseam: 28"
- **Large (L)**: Bust: 44", Waist: 40", Hips: 47", Shoulder: 15.2", Kurti Length: 41", Sleeve Length: 22.5", Trouser Length: 39", Inseam: 28.5"
- **Extra Large (XL)**: Bust: 47", Waist: 44", Hips: 50", Shoulder: 16.0", Kurti Length: 42", Sleeve Length: 23", Trouser Length: 40", Inseam: 29"

### Standard Kurti & Trouser Measurements (Centimeters)
- **Extra Small (XS)**: Bust: 91.4 cm, Waist: 81.3 cm, Hips: 96.5 cm, Shoulder: 34.3 cm, Kurti Length: 96.5 cm, Sleeve Length: 53.3 cm, Trouser Length: 91.4 cm
- **Small (S)**: Bust: 96.5 cm, Waist: 86.4 cm, Hips: 101.6 cm, Shoulder: 35.6 cm, Kurti Length: 99.1 cm, Sleeve Length: 54.6 cm, Trouser Length: 94.0 cm
- **Medium (M)**: Bust: 104.1 cm, Waist: 94.0 cm, Hips: 111.8 cm, Shoulder: 36.8 cm, Kurti Length: 101.6 cm, Sleeve Length: 55.9 cm, Trouser Length: 96.5 cm
- **Large (L)**: Bust: 111.8 cm, Waist: 101.6 cm, Hips: 119.4 cm, Shoulder: 38.6 cm, Kurti Length: 104.1 cm, Sleeve Length: 57.2 cm, Trouser Length: 99.1 cm
- **Extra Large (XL)**: Bust: 119.4 cm, Waist: 111.8 cm, Hips: 127.0 cm, Shoulder: 40.6 cm, Kurti Length: 106.7 cm, Sleeve Length: 58.4 cm, Trouser Length: 101.6 cm

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants
**Q: Can a client living abroad (UK, USA, UAE, Canada) order stitching from SARTOR?**
A: Yes. Overseas clients can select standard brand sizes or submit their measurements via WhatsApp (+92 335 2209991). SARTOR can source the unstitched designer lawn, chiffon, banarsi silk, or velvet fabric directly from Lahore markets on the client's behalf, stitch the garments, and courier them internationally or deliver to their family residence in Pakistan.

**Q: Does SARTOR stitch unstitched designer suits from brands like Maria.B, Sapphire, Sana Safinaz, and Asim Jofa?**
A: Yes, SARTOR specializes in stitching unstitched 3-piece designer collections with all included accessories, embroideries, laces, tassels, and organza extensions applied cleanly to high couture standards.

**Q: How does a customer schedule a pickup in Lahore?**
A: Customers can click the WhatsApp button on the website or message +92 335 2209991 with their Lahore address and preferred pickup time. A representative will collect the fabric and measurements.
